readings.SAME_SIGN: avoid slope > 0 with CI excluding 0 and above the random max (refutes)
readings.INSIDE_FLOOR: |avoid slope| not above the random max, or CI includes zero: the effect does not transfer to the avoid framing (neither support nor refutation; counts against the robustness claim)

floor_rule: (a) if |s_c| <= M160; (b) if |s_c| > M160 and |s_c| >= valence_full/2; (c) otherwise; s_c = the concept-control run's recorded full-160 concept slope, M160 = max_k |slope_k| over the 24 random directions re-run on all 160 skeletons, valence_full = the concept-control run's re-run full-160 valence slope on this model
